s0.title: [QA] Playwright failure-analysis detail component (b6e/_6e) inlined in the eagerly-loaded entry bundle assets/index-BZPqRl0e.js — 545KB on the wire, ~2.0MB decoded, parsed on every page load
s0.body:
The app's main entry script https://qa.replay.io/assets/index-BZPqRl0e.js decodes to 2,047,267 bytes (~2000KB) while only 557,596 bytes (545KB) travel on the wire br-compressed. A body read of the bundle shows one concrete waste source: the rarely-invoked Playwright failure-analysis detail component — function b6e (the 'bug-report playwright-failure-report' report renderer, bundle lines 99727–100010) and its route container _6e (lines 100011–100036) — is inlined in this eagerly-loaded chunk, even though it only ever renders at the deep route :projectId/playwright-tests/:analysisId (lines 115181–115182), a URL requiring both a specific project ID and analysis ID that a normal visitor never opens. Its full report UI, including the collapsible 'Test source and context' section that renders the raw test source into a <pre> (line 100003), is shipped and parsed on every first load of the app. The bundle's own __vite__mapDeps table shows the build already emits 35 lazy chunks, so eager inlining of this detail view is avoidable.

**Actual behavior**
GET https://qa.replay.io/assets/index-BZPqRl0e.js returns 200 with content-encoding: br and content-length 557,596 bytes (545KB on the wire); the body decodes to 2,047,267 chars (~2000KB) and contains the b6e/_6e Playwright analysis detail component inline at lines 99727–100036, wired to route :projectId/playwright-tests/:analysisId at lines 115181–115182. Every first-time visitor to the site downloads and parses this rarely-invoked detail-page code as part of the entry bundle, regardless of navigation intent.

**Expected behavior**
The Playwright failure-analysis detail component (b6e/_6e) — the report renderer for the rarely-visited :projectId/playwright-tests/:analysisId route — should be split into its own lazily-loaded chunk (as the build already does for the 35 chunks enumerated in __vite__mapDeps, e.g. AdminUsers, LineChart), so every-first-load visitors do not download and parse its code as part of the ~2.0MB entry script.

— Filed by Replay QA ([bug-mu8z8bor-g25v](https://qa.replay.io/projects/proj-qa-replay-io-mrgtvysw/bugs/bug-mu8z8bor-g25v))
